example_chunk_texts.5493: We mourned my mother. My dad fully healed. He had some amazing doctors. And when he healed, we brought him home and he got better and then we had the funerals. And when we pieced things together and we found these things out about Toby, all these things came out. As soon as we saw that Steve had a restraining order against this man as a credible threat of violence, as soon as we saw that he had been dishonorably discharged from the military, as soon as we saw that he had all these things stacked up against him and pretty much anybody you talk to would say that, oh yeah, that guy's dangerous, as soon as we realized all this stuff and he still owned three guns and a handful of extended magazines and essentially an arsenal, we realized we needed to do something because we can't let this just happen. because the community I live in just accepts it as an urban problem. It's an issue that we never thought would touch us. It's an issue that we thought was a problem that was, you know, 45 minutes away in Los Angeles, but we didn't accept that it happens in Thousand Oaks because we live in the safest city in America.
